   561	def _level_permits(level, frame):
   562	    ftype = frame[0]
   563	    if ftype in ("PADDING", "PING"):
   564	        return True
   565	    if ftype in ("ACK", "CRYPTO"):
   566	        return level in ("I", "H", "A")
   567	    if ftype in ("STREAM", "RESET_STREAM", "STOP_SENDING"):
   568	        return level in ("Z", "A")
   569	    if ftype == "CLOSE":
   570	        if frame[1]:
   571	            return level in ("Z", "A")
   572	        return True
   573	    return False

   576	def _ranges_contain(ranges, starts, low, high):
   577	    """True when [low, high] is fully covered by the sorted `ranges`."""
   578	    index = bisect.bisect_right(starts, low) - 1
   579	    if index < 0:
   580	        return False
   581	    pos = low
   582	    total = len(ranges)
   583	    while index < total:
   584	        start, stop = ranges[index]
   585	        if start > pos:
   586	            return False
   587	        if stop >= high:
   588	            return True
   589	        pos = stop + 1
   590	        index += 1
   591	    return False
